product.name: Dawarha RVMs
product.description: Automated machines for recycling plastic bottles and cans, offering users Dawarha Coins as rewards.

product.name: Dawarha Coins
product.description: A digital currency earned through recycling activities, redeemable for various rewards within the Dawarha ecosystem.

product.name: Dawarha Store
product.description: An online platform within the Dawarha app where users can redeem Dawarha Coins for discounts, vouchers, and products.

product.name: Mobile App
product.description: Provides access to Dawarha's recycling services, including account management, coin balance, and store purchases.

product.name: Account Management
product.description: A service allowing users to manage their Dawarha account settings, including freezing or deleting their account.
